title: Feature request: dates in careportal
symptom: In the care portal, information is separated by day by a gray bar containing text. The first 7 days feature texts such as 'today', 'yesterday', '2 days ago', etc. Starting from the 8th day, hard dates appear as text. If you are looking for something within the first 7 days, it requires some calculation to determine the correct date. If you analyze a screenshot of one of the first days, it is not even immediately possible to determine which date it concerns. Unnecessarily difficult.
fix: The thread suggests replacing the vague indications above the first 7 days with a hard date, possibly supplementing with day names like 'Monday', 'Tuesday'. A maintainer agreed and proposed to show both, and a commit was linked as resolution.
evidence_quote: Proposal to replace the vague indications above the first 7 days with a hard date. Perhaps supplement this for the first 7 days with "Monday", "Tuesday", etc.
